title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI can now write code faster than you can type?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenSource AI tools are changing how devs work — and it’s just getting started.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that writes, debugs, and optimizes code in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a unique hybrid model that combines code generation with real-time error detection.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects every developer — saving hours daily on repetitive coding tasks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? OpenCode is making high-quality AI coding accessible to all.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried an open source AI coding tool yet?
